in.rationale: The manual source/path audit narrows the missing correspondence but does not close it.

notes: Manual inspection and tests remain supporting evidence, not cross-language theorem verification.
rules: Every record and link keeps its recorded state; most are PROPOSED (AI-drafted, unreviewed). Say so when you use them.
A link is a recorded connection, not a verified relationship. An empty path_eligibility means the link may not be chained to carry a result into another setting.
Cite the paper and the PDF page in the record's sources, and check the paper before relying on a claim.
Counts are indexed records, not distinct ideas or papers. Absence of a record is a gap in the atlas, not evidence that nothing exists.
state_meaning: A named person reviewed this record or link at its stated scope.
text: A source-and-trace review compares history order, exact arithmetic, strict cutoffs, stage order, early stops, and five path cases; it reports no observed semantic mismatch but does not prove distribution equality.
title: Manual Python-to-Lean path audit
